stances_toward.note: A mortal enemy in the ontology's sense: the TTP fights to overthrow the Pakistani state and the government's declared aim is 'complete elimination' of the 'Fitna al-Khawarij' (President Zardari after the Kohat attack, Sept 2026). Militants killed more than 600 soldiers and police in 2025, mostly in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan (Crisis Group); the 8 Oct 2025 ambush that killed 11 soldiers led to Pakistan's first air strikes on Kabul, aimed at the TTP chief. The Kohat attack of 18 Sep 2026 was claimed by a different alliance, Ittehad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan. Bond - grievance.

relations_to.summary: After the TTP ambush of 8 Oct 2025 that killed 11 Pakistani military personnel Pakistan carried out cross-border air strikes, including its first on Kabul, reportedly aimed at TTP chief Noor Wali Mehsud; militants killed more than 600 Pakistani soldiers and police in 2025.
